name: How do I choose the right color temperature for my kitchen lights?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right color temperature for my kitchen lights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right color temperature for your kitchen lights depends on the desired ambiance and functionality. Color temperature is measured in Kelvin (K). Lower Kelvin values (2700K-3000K) produce a warm, yellowish light, similar to traditional incandescent bulbs, ideal for a cozy, inviting atmosphere. Higher Kelvin values (3500K-5000K) produce a cooler, whiter light that mimics natural daylight, which is excellent for task-oriented areas like food preparation. Many modern LED fixtures offer adjustable color temperatures, allowing you to switch between warm and cool light as needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select color temperature based on desired ambiance: warm (2700K-3000K) for a cozy feel, or cool white (3500K-5000K) for task lighting. Adjustable options are also available.
